identity_verification_2026_09_15.reason: Well-Pict's own identity is not remotely in doubt: decades of trade coverage (Supermarket News, The Packer, Produce News), a long-established Watsonville, CA strawberry/berry grower-shipper. Held provisional for the same reason as Gem-Pack Berries above (symmetric treatment of the same unresolved affiliation question): trade press reports Gem-Pack and Well-Pict Berries 'combining companies,' and this mission does not have enough information to say whether that means a full merger, a marketing partnership, or something else -- promoting one side without the other would misrepresent the current, uncertain state of that relationship.
